title: Starter tiles and stepwise canvas for Embeddings + Rerank onboarding
creator: Avery Chen
description: Design a compact visual kit (starter tiles) and a 'stepwise canvas' walkthrough for the Embeddings + Rerank quickstart. Assets will be used across docs, Console onboarding, and the interactive playground. Deliverables: pipeline diagram (annotated), 3 screenshot variants (compact card, expanded pipeline, annotated output), copy snippets for microcopy and tooltips, accessibility notes, and an export-ready Figma file and PNG/JPG screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file contains Starter Tiles page, Stepwise Canvas page, and annotated pipeline artboard
Three screenshot variants exported at required sizes (320x180, 1200x675, 1600x900) with clear legible copy
Pipeline diagram shows data flow: ingest -> embed -> index -> rerank -> final output, with technical callouts for caching & batching
Microcopy snippets (headline, step captions, CTA) reviewed and approved by PM
Assets handed off with naming conventions and accessibility alt text for each image
Design QA performed in Console mock to validate legibility at smallest size
assets_needed: Sample dataset snippets (3 short examples of queries + expected rerank outputs)
Component screenshots from Console (token cost breakdown card)

notes: Make screenshots generic (no customer PII). Use synthetic sample queries that illustrate common mis-ranks and the improvement after rerank. Keep final assets lightweight for SDK docs and large for marketing page if needed.
